> 第25章 萧炎的规划（第1页）
萧炎的规划（萧炎的规划（第22页）等萧炎哥哥达到斗皇级别，薰儿会将关于自己的一切，都告诉萧炎哥哥，但在那之前，萧炎哥哥安心修炼便是，给你的那些资源，只算在我的头上，并不算在家族的身上，希望萧炎哥哥不要因此而有任何的芥蒂。”萧炎闻言笑了笑，伸手轻抚薰儿的头发，轻笑道：“给我六年时间，我会晋级斗皇的。”话音刚落，薰儿就一愣。啊？六年？一年一个境界吗？这不太可能吧……但想到是比起自己还要更加天赋强大的萧炎哥哥，薰儿倒是觉得这也不是不可能。“那，薰儿很期待那一天呢！”她笑意盈盈地颔首说道。“我靠，你小子疯啦？”药老的声音，在萧炎心中响起。要知道，萧炎现在还只是一名斗者。要在接下来的六年内突破到斗王境界，以药老的手段和薰儿送给萧炎的大量修炼资源，倒是有几分可能。但要到达斗皇境界？那可太难了！除非福缘深厚，机缘逆天，才有那么一些可能。“好啦，该修炼了！你先消化一下我给你传的那些经验。”既然已经是做出了承诺，萧炎是要付诸于行动。有压力，更有动力！如今有药老在身边，他根本不担心自己的修炼速度，敢说要突破到斗皇，也并非是无的放矢。青莲地心火，海心焰，陨落心炎，三道异火，足够他提升很多了。他可没有所谓的三年修炼空洞期，即便时间节点对不上，但资源就在那里，不会消失，就看他能不能吃得下去了！此外，还有体内万兽灵火，培养到成熟期之后，理论上来说，萧炎有可能搞到四种异火，别说斗皇了，就是斗宗强者来了，也得被他炸死！修炼火焰拳，让萧炎多了不少压缩斗气的经验，这种经验，完全可以用在压缩火焰之上。虽然目前因为没有两种火焰，以及焚诀的关系，萧炎并不能够尝试凝聚佛怒火莲，但是他可以通过炼药术和压缩斗气，来增长自己对斗气和灵魂力量的掌控力，如此一来，到时候萧炎就可以更加容易的掌握凝聚佛怒火莲的方法了。说起来，再过半个月，就是迦南学院的招生之日了。但萧炎暂时不打算去。要去也是直接通过选拔赛进入到内院中去，借助天焚炼气塔的力量，快速提升自己的实力。在外院修行，完全就是浪费时间。不过要通过内院选拔赛，至少也要有大斗师的实力。萧炎还需要一些时间去修炼。此外，薰儿如今也才刚刚晋级一星斗者，萧炎还是希望和她一起去迦南学院的，如此一来，至少也还需要两年左右的时间。这两年的时间，得好好规划一下，魔兽山脉，该走一趟了，得把紫云翼拿到手。

> Chapter 25 Xiao Yan’s plan (page 1)
Xiao Yan's plan (Xiao Yan's plan (page 22)) When brother Xiao Yan reaches the level of Dou Huang, Xun'er will tell brother Xiao Yan everything about him, but before that, brother Xiao Yan can practice with peace of mind. The resources given to you only count on my head and not on the family. I hope brother Xiao Yan will not have any grudges because of this." Xiao Yan smiled after hearing this. He stretched out his hand and stroked Xun'er's hair, and said with a smile: "Give me six years, and I will be promoted to Dou Huang." Xun'er was stunned as soon as she finished speaking. Huh? Six years? One realm per year? That's not possible... But considering that it's brother Xiao Yan who is even more talented than herself, Xun'er thinks it's not impossible. "Well, Xun'er is looking forward to that day!" "Damn it, are you crazy?" Yao Lao's voice sounded in Xiao Yan's heart. You know, Xiao Yan is still just a fighter. It is somewhat possible to reach the Dou King realm with Yao Lao's methods and the large amount of training resources Xun'er gave Xiao Yan. But that would be too difficult! There are some possibilities. "Okay, it's time to practice! First digest the experience I taught you." Now that he has made a promise, Xiao Yan has to put it into action. Now that Yao Lao is by his side, he is not worried about his cultivation speed at all. It is not unreasonable to dare to break through to Dou Huang. Three strange fires are enough for him to improve a lot. He doesn't have the so-called three-year cultivation period. Even if the time is not right, the resources are there and will not disappear. It depends on whether he can eat them! In addition, there is also the beast spirit fire in his body. After cultivating it to a mature stage, Xiao Yan can theoretically get four kinds of strange fires. Not to mention the Dou Emperor, even if the Dou Zong master comes, He has to kill him! Practicing the flame fist has given Xiao Yan a lot of experience in compressing fighting energy. This experience can be used in compressing flames. Although Xiao Yan is currently unable to try to condense the Buddha's Angry Fire Lotus due to the lack of two kinds of flames, but he can increase his control over fighting energy and soul power through refining medicine and compressing fighting energy. By then, Xiao Yan will be able to master the method of condensing the Buddha's Fury Lotus more easily. Speaking of which, it will be the enrollment day of Canaan Academy for the time being. But Xiao Yan does not plan to go directly to the inner courtyard through the trial, and it is a complete waste of time to use the power of the Tianfen Qi Refining Tower to quickly improve his strength. In the inner court trial, Xiao Yan still needs some time to practice. In addition, Xun'er has just been promoted to a one-star fighter. Xiao Yan still hopes to go to Canaan Academy with her. In this case, it will take at least two years. In the past two years, it is time to make a trip to the Warcraft Mountains and get the Ziyun Wing.
